name: M3_PPS200MI_DltLine
description: Delete a purchase order line and all its connected records from related objects in M3. The operation removes the selected line and any associated line-level information so that it no longer appears in purchase order inquiries, follow-up, or reporting.

inputParameters.name: PUNO
inputParameters.description: Purchase order number containing the line to delete.

inputParameters.name: PNLI
inputParameters.description: Purchase order line number identifying the line to delete.

inputParameters.name: PNLS
inputParameters.description: Purchase order line suffix identifying the specific split of the line to delete when sublines exist.
